name: clarify-proofstory-candidate-ledger-scheduler-boundary
title: Clarify candidate milestone ledgers and scheduler boundary in ProofStory plan
description: The ProofStory execution plan needs two precision edits before M0-M2 implementation: fix the progressive rule count, and clarify that milestone ledgers can be drafted before intent collision but become gate-consumed only after accepted intent interpretation. It should also state that slicing is required for oversized ledgers while automatic parallel child-story execution belongs to a later Scheduler/Unattended/Autopilot story.
